line: Crowley on Atu IX: the letter Yod, the Hand, Virgo ruled by Mercury, and the Father who is Wisdom (pdf p79, p80).

sections.title: Letter and sign
sections.line: Crowley on the letter Yod, the Hand (pdf p79), and on Virgo, ruled by Mercury, with Mercury exalted there (pdf p80).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Yod, which means the Hand.
this is reflected in the attribution of the card to the sign of Virgo
Yet not only is Virgo ruled by Mercury, but Mercury is exalted therein.

sections.title: Yod as the Father
sections.line: Crowley on Yod as the symbol of the Father, who is Wisdom, and on the Father as the highest form of Mercury and the Logos (pdf p79).

quotes.quote: The letter Yod is the first letter of the name Tetragrammaton, and this symbolizes the Father, who is Wisdom;
he is the highest form of Mercury, and the Logos, the Creator of all
